# Soulstorm Meta Campaigns — Source library

Version 0.1 • 2026-09-15 • Development baseline

Reusable scaffolding is separate from the suspended Dessica test campaign. This is not the finished rebalanced edition. Inherited numerical rules remain provisional; proposed changes are in the dated notes.

| Document | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Source_Rules.md | Reusable inherited rules, new source directions and known conflicts |
| Campaign_Template.md | Blank setup, state registers, ledger and narrative framework |
| Briefing_Commander_Template.md | Rival AI commander and declared-action format |
| Briefing_Advisor_Template.md | Player advisor and recommended-action format |
| Faction_Control_Handover_Template.md | Player/AI swaps without state changes |
| Game_Master_Guide.md | Setup, colours, personnel, resolution, publication and testing |
| Campaign_Notes_2026-09-15.md | Dated backlog, suspension and original notes |

Web reference: https://noxanimusvicta.github.io/Soulstorm-Meta-Campaigns/source.html
Campaign: https://noxanimusvicta.github.io/Soulstorm-Meta-Campaigns/
Repository: https://github.com/NoxAnimusVicta/Soulstorm-Meta-Campaigns • branch main

Fill the blank framework, pin a source version and instantiate briefings. Approved source releases affect new campaigns; existing campaigns need an explicit migration. Templates contain no active event or faction orders. Campaign_Template.md needs a new-campaign parser adaptation before it can feed Dessica's name-specific builder.

Provenance: Dessica rules through Cycle 21; user notes dated on receipt 15 September 2026; three historical briefings used for structure and voice only. Pilot simulations and a shared-Major integration checkpoint are available; full-game validation and preset tables remain unfinished. See the simulation report and development handover.

## Balance laboratory — 15 September 2026

Balance_Simulation_Methods.md specifies scope and assumptions; Balance_Simulation_Report.md records the first calibration experiments. Download Balance_Simulation_Bundle.zip for reproducible code and data. This is a frontier/diagnostic pilot, not a full-game balance certification. Military resource clarification and source-export corrections do not alter suspended Dessica.
